title: GPC: Large-Scale Generative Pretraining for Transferable Motor Control
abstract: GPC (Generative Pretrained Controllers) leverages tokenization and next-token modeling to create general-purpose, reusable generative controllers for physics-based character animation from large-scale motion datasets. The framework jointly optimizes a discrete 'motion vocabulary' via Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) together with a control policy using end-to-end reinforcement learning, then models the token structure with a GPT-style autoregressive transformer. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (CoLA) adapts the pretrained controller to downstream tasks. Trained on 600+ hours of motion, GPC reaches a 99.98% tracking success rate and exhibits emergent behaviors such as perturbation responses and fall recovery.
